help_content:
Welcome to the travel experience world!

SeeYourTravel.app is a community where you can share, refresh and plan your travels and share memories with your friends.

Any questions: info@seeyourtravel.app
Corporate_Text1: Experience the travels yourself from past, today and future!  We are happy to be with you.
Corporate_Global1: Global coverage with no extra effort
Corporate_Friendly1: Easy to use and pleasant to come back
Corporate_Norway1: Severe nature and open-heart people - paradise in the North
Corporate_Germany1: Quiet and relaxing, busy and inspiring - the real Germany
Corporate_Ukraine1: Nature, people, food - all what you need to enjoy the life
Corporate_Italy1: See yourself the beauty of Italian life and history
Corporate_FeelFree: Feel free to contact us at

ShareLocationOnNote: Your position (about 100 m accuracy) is visible to other users who share theirs. Turning this off deletes your saved positions.
ShareLocationConfirm:
Share your position with other users who also share theirs?

- Only your last position of the past hour is shown, rounded to about 100 m, with your user name.
- Others can only see you if they share their own position.
- You can switch it off at any time; this deletes your saved positions.
